essence: The half-Lakshmi-Hari form is established through the Shri seed in a six-limbed arrangement.
The seed syllable is to be pronounced with an anusvara.
The obeisance formula is to be used everywhere in the procedure.
The invoked figures are to be visualized as radiant like lightning and holding a lotus and the gesture of fearlessness.
The mantra pattern is om shrim am followed by the deity name, the goddess name, and namaḥ, continuing similarly.
